text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our outing was over, and we were supposed 
to be heading back to the academy... or so 
I thought.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da~! The Ultimate Feng Shui Good Luck 
Tour! Starts nooow!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pushed from behind, we were bundled onto a 
bus without understanding what was going 
on... We were the only passengers on 
board.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll be your tour guide for today, Copano 
Rickey♪ I hope you all enjoy it until the 
very end!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking you on a tour of lucky spots 
found using your natal star, Trainer! Come 
on, just kick back and enjoy yourself!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
First up is the observation deck! I 
figured a place with a great view would 
suit you well!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It'd be great to enjoy the breathtaking 
view here and get yourself an orange item!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And so, here you go! It's got the logo of 
this observation deck on it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome♪ Be sure to wear it as 
much as you can☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The eastern direction is auspicious too! 
It's an exceptionally powerful energy spot 
among them!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Mmm, hehehe. No, no, it's nothing...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, maybe I'll ask anyway!? How are you 
feeling right now?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: All riiight! Onto the next one then!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The tour continued, with only Copano 
Rickey knowing the destinations. She'd ask 
for my thoughts now and then, but I had no 
idea what the goal was...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here's the final stop! Please 
enjoy the hot springs and delicious food!!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text:
I have been waiting for you. Thank you 
very much for your help the other day...

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all of you helping us get back 
on our feet, customers have slowly started 
returning... I would be delighted if you'd 
allow me to offer a small token of 
gratitude today.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Today, the locals all pitched in together 
to charter a bus and prepare food for us!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: For the Trainer's sake, you know!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but still!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to use Feng Shui to make everyone 
happy and lucky, you know?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though, some things are hard to do 
alone. Whenever I'm feeling frustrated, 
you're always there to help, aren't you, 
Trainer?”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Like someone who'll give you a little 
boost when you're just one step away from 
reaching your goal. That's the kind of 
person I think they are!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Then, before making everyone happy, I 
thought I should make the person who 
supports me the most smile first!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And so, when I talked to the inn staff 
about wanting to treat you, every single 
one of them pitched in to help! They even 
lent us a bus!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I keep dragging you into things, and I can 
never thank you enough... but here's a 
little token of my appreciation!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'll continue to be in your care!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, you're definitely caught up in 
this...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yay!! You felt the exact same way!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! As long as you're my Trainer, I 
promise I'll make you super happy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"From now on, she will surely keep making 
people happy in her own way. I resolved 
once again to support her until the very 
end."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Urk! I-I mean, I do feel bad about that, 
but~...
choice_data_list: Still, that's one of Rickey's good points.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...That's what you meant by that!? Aw 
man, you totally freaked me out for 
nothing!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, if that's the case, I won't 
hold back! Guess I'll keep dragging you 
along with me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"From now on, she will surely keep making 
people happy in her own way. I resolved 
once again to support her until the very 
end."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why are you crying!? Were you that 
moved?! Aww, I'm so happy!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I wanted to make you laugh, but 
this works too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please keep laughing a lot and 
crying a lot with me from now on too! 
Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"From now on, she will surely keep making 
people happy in her own way. I resolved 
once again to support her until the very 
end."
